caption: The drawing depicts a glass vessel with a domed lid and a thick stemmed base, resembling a goblet or display jar, positioned centrally on a plain, slightly yellowed background. The vessel is filled with layers of colored sand that form horizontal stripes in brown, tan, white, blue, and a zigzag of red and green. Within the central section of the jar, the sand layers are arranged to create a landscape scene featuring a body of light blue water, a brown shoreline, green grass, and a brown mountain range beneath a pale blue sky. A small, white sailboat with a triangular sail is present on the water. The artist’s signature, "R.W. Poindexter," appears in blue in the lower right corner of the paper.
title: Sand Picture
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
